@graph.description: This repository contains a reproduction attempt of the experiments from the BMC Bioinformatics 2025 publication titled 'An Evaluation Methodology for Machine Learning-Based Tandem Mass Spectra Similarity Prediction'. The project focuses on creating a benchmarking pipeline for future ML-based MS/MS similarity approaches. A preprocessing pipeline harmonizes metadata from GNPS Libraries and MassBank EU, filters invalid entries, and prepares train/test splits. The benchmarking process trains MS2DeepScore on an all-pairs dataset and evaluates performance on filtered test data to minimize overhead.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: Reproduction of an evaluation methodology for ML-based MS/MS similarity prediction
